_comment: Paths are relative to --data-root (default ../data-physio; raw logs are never committed). role: dev = primary development data (clean, complete, footers present); regression = fixed test cases with known acquisition faults that the QC must keep flagging. Participants are labelled S01/S02; sessions pre/post refer to two visits of the same participant.

S01_pre.note: PPG clipping 4.5%; resp has no footer

S01_post.note: puls flat 2048 (sensor not connected); resp has no footer
